Sales Admin Support Job at Ascentech Services Limited




        
    

        
        Ascentech Services Limited is a full-fledged Human Resource Solution Provider incorporated in 2013 with its Head Office in Lagos, Nigeria. We are committed to forging long-term partnerships with our clients by creating and delivering robust and flexible services that address the changing needs of their business.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Sales Admin Support

Job Location: llupeju, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Lubricant & Polymers

Position Summary
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	The Sales Support provides technical and commercial support to the sales team. This role serves as a key liaison between sales, technical, production, and customers to ensure accurate quotations, product compliance, timely delivery, and customer satisfaction.


Required Skills & Qualifications


	A first Degree or its equivalent in chemistry.
	2-3 years of hands on experience
	Good oral and written communication skills.
	Good customer service and relationship management tools.
	Good data gathering and analysis skills.
	Good problem analysis and solving skills.
	Proficiency in ERP/CRM systems and Microsoft Excel.


Salary
N300,000 monthly Net.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the Subject of the mail.

  "description": "MyMedicalBank is a health technology company with a vision to revolutionise access to healthcare in Nigeria through creating digital solutions that connect consumers with healthcare providers, health information and their health records from their smartphone.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Digital Growth Manager

Job Location: Lagos

Job Summary


	Utilize advanced digital marketing skills to attract a constant stream of paying customers to MyMedicalBank and drive organic downloads of the MyMedicalBank app.


Responsibilities


	Design, implement, test, iterate and scale growth marketing strategies that attract prospects and convert leads with minimal human interaction.
	Implement strategies to aggressively increase app download and drive online sales growth through maximizing traffic and conversion rates.
	Create contents to be utilized for sales copy, blogging, video, offers, promotions and social media feed.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
	Drive online sales growth through maximizing traffic, conversions, A/B testing and ROI
	Use knowledge of automated bid tools, real-time bidding, retargeting, Facebook&rsquo;s algorithms, SEO and Google Ads to optimize campaigns.
	Create a retention strategy to drive repeat sales and loyalty of our customer base
	Keep up to date with the latest trends and changes in UI/UX and translate them into improvements for our website and app.
	Continually harvest insights from our data, and identify clear opportunities for digital growth and where to allocate the digital spend. Develop and maintain dashboards to easily digest actionable insights.&nbsp;
	Develop the digital calendar, schedules and clear regular plans to deliver new customer focused objectives.
	Drive digital initiatives working with brand partnerships, influencers, media and others to identify opportunities to encourage usage of MyMedicalBank to access healthcare


Person Specifications


	Strong digital marketing experience with a successful track record in sustainable customer acquisition, conversion and retention across paid and organic marketing channels.&nbsp;
	Excellent working knowledge of Google Analytics, Google Ads, Facebook Business Manager, Content Marketing and Social Media Marketing
	Experience with Zoho CRM, Zoho Campaigns, Zoho Analytics and Email Marketing.
	Excellent understanding of B2B2C model, SEO, SEM and paid digital media.
	Good understanding of how a CMS works (Wordpress preferred) and basic knowledge of HTML.&nbsp;

	Skilled at applying a customer journey mindset to remove blockers, build automation and engagement across multiple channels.

	Experience with creating high impact digital content including sales copy, pitches, templates, automated funnels articles and videos&nbsp;
	Experience of working in a fast-paced and ambitious high growth environment&nbsp;
	Knowledge of trends in the healthcare/ ICT industry an advantage.&nbsp;

Digital Growth Manager Job at MyMedicalBank




        
    

        
        MyMedicalBank is a health technology company with a vision to revolutionise access to healthcare in Nigeria through creating digital solutions that connect consumers with healthcare providers, health information and their health records from their smartphone.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Digital Growth Manager

Job Location: Lagos

Job Summary


	Utilize advanced digital marketing skills to attract a constant stream of paying customers to MyMedicalBank and drive organic downloads of the MyMedicalBank app.


Responsibilities
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Design, implement, test, iterate and scale growth marketing strategies that attract prospects and convert leads with minimal human interaction.
	Implement strategies to aggressively increase app download and drive online sales growth through maximizing traffic and conversion rates.
	Create contents to be utilized for sales copy, blogging, video, offers, promotions and social media feed.   
	Drive online sales growth through maximizing traffic, conversions, A/B testing and ROI
	Use knowledge of automated bid tools, real-time bidding, retargeting, Facebook’s algorithms, SEO and Google Ads to optimize campaigns.
	Create a retention strategy to drive repeat sales and loyalty of our customer base
	Keep up to date with the latest trends and changes in UI/UX and translate them into improvements for our website and app.
	Continually harvest insights from our data, and identify clear opportunities for digital growth and where to allocate the digital spend. Develop and maintain dashboards to easily digest actionable insights. 
	Develop the digital calendar, schedules and clear regular plans to deliver new customer focused objectives.
	Drive digital initiatives working with brand partnerships, influencers, media and others to identify opportunities to encourage usage of MyMedicalBank to access healthcare


Person Specifications


	Strong digital marketing experience with a successful track record in sustainable customer acquisition, conversion and retention across paid and organic marketing channels. 
	Excellent working knowledge of Google Analytics, Google Ads, Facebook Business Manager, Content Marketing and Social Media Marketing
	Experience with Zoho CRM, Zoho Campaigns, Zoho Analytics and Email Marketing.
	Excellent understanding of B2B2C model, SEO, SEM and paid digital media.
	Good understanding of how a CMS works (Wordpress preferred) and basic knowledge of HTML. 
	Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with the ability to turn complex datasets into insights that drive solutions and strategies.
	Skilled at applying a customer journey mindset to remove blockers, build automation and engagement across multiple channels.
	Ideally some basic knowledge of graphic design. 
	Experience with creating high impact digital content including sales copy, pitches, templates, automated funnels articles and videos 
	Experience of working in a fast-paced and ambitious high growth environment 
	Knowledge of trends in the healthcare/ ICT industry an advantage.

        Stockgap Fuels Limited is a leading oil and gas company operating in Nigeria’s downstream sector with head office in Port Harcourt, Rivers State. To meet the growing demand of Nigeria’s Market, Stockgap Fuels Limited is expanding its LPG business by investing on additional storage and cylinder filling facility in 4 strategic locations spanning major regions of the country - Lagos/South-West, South-South/South-East, North-Central/North-West and North-East regions respectively.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Document Controller & CPMO Coordinator

Ref Code: CPMO-DC-01
Job Location: Head Office with site travel across Abuja, Port Harcourt, Ikene, Gombe, and Ogun.
Employment Type: Full-time
Reporting To: Chief Program Management Officer (CPMO)
Sector: Capital Projects / EPC Document Management

Role Overview


	Stockgap Fuels Limited is seeking qualified  engineering and project management professionals for full-time positions within the Office of the Chief Program Management Officer (CPMO).
	Manage all project correspondence, transmittals, technical documentation, and turnover dossiers across the CPMO portfolio while providing executive coordination support (meeting minutes, action tracking, and calendar management).


Key Responsibilities


	EDMS Management: Maintain the central project repository (EDMS / SharePoint) with standardized folder hierarchies, document numbering, and revision controls.
	Transmittals & Drawing Control: Register, distribute, and track incoming/outgoing correspondence, contractor transmittals, drawings, datasheets, and ITPs.
	Turnover Dossiers: Compile and audit complete handover packages, inspection records, regulatory permits, and variation orders.
	Executive Coordination: Draft agendas and minutes for Steering Committee and CPMO meetings, manage action logs, and consolidate weekly/monthly dashboards.


Key Requirements


	Education: B.Sc/B.Eng or HND in Engineering, Information Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
	Required Experience: 5–8 years total document control experience (minimum 3 years on engineering/capital projects)
	Track Record: Hands-on experience compiling at least one complete project turnover handover package.
	Software Tools: Proficiency in SharePoint, EDMS, or Aconex, alongside advanced MS Excel skills (registers, pivot tables, trackers).


Method of Application

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Site Engineer Receunt foJob",
  "description": "BTech Construction Limited is the construction and project delivery company within a growing group based in Abuja. We deliver building projects to programme, specification and budget, and we are looking for an experienced Site Engineer to take charge of execution on our project sites.

This is a site based appointment. The Site Engineer is the execution authority on each assigned site: the person who keeps work moving, holds every trade to standard and tells the Project Manager what is happening before they need to ask. We are looking for someone with the confidence and judgement to run day to day delivery, and the discipline to stay accountable on programme, cost and quality.

We are &nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Site Engineer

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) - Project sites across Nigeria
Employment Type: Full-time, site based

The Opportunity


	We are looking for an experienced Site Engineer to take charge of execution on our project sites.
	This is a site based appointment. The Site Engineer is the execution authority on each assigned site: the person who keeps work moving, holds every trade to standard and tells the Project Manager what is happening before they need to ask. We are looking for someone with the confidence and judgement to run day to day delivery, and the discipline to stay accountable on programme, cost and quality.
	The role involves working at project sites across Nigeria, and candidates should be willing to be based wherever the work requires.


The Role


	Running the site: You will manage assigned sites from mobilisation to practical completion, directing site workers, subcontractors and artisans daily. You will prepare daily and weekly execution plans against the approved programme and check that all works meet specification and are properly sequenced.
	Technical control: You will read and implement architectural, structural and MEP drawings and specifications, confirm setting out, levels and dimensions, and coordinate trades to avoid clashes. Any difference between the drawings and site conditions is raised at once.
	Programme, materials and people: You will track progress against programme, report delays with a recovery plan and hold subcontractors to their milestones. You will prepare accurate material requisitions, count and verify every delivery before it is signed off, and keep labour working where it is most productive.
	Health and safety: You will enforce PPE and site rules without exception, carry out daily safety checks and confirm that temporary works, scaffolding and access are safe before use. Incidents and near misses are reported immediately, with incident reports completed within 24 hours.
	Records and reporting: You will produce clear daily and weekly site reports and maintain the site diary, inspection records, delivery notes and as built records, all filed correctly in our Microsoft 365 and SharePoint system.


Who We Are Looking For


	A Degree or HND in Building Engineering or a related construction discipline
	At least five years of hands on site experience, including large or complex construction projects
	The technical competence to read and interpret full sets of architectural, structural and MEP drawings without assistance
	Proven authority supervising site workers, subcontractors and artisans across several projects at once
	A disciplined approach to health and safety, site rules and documentation
	A clear, direct communicator who writes structured site reports and raises problems early


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and a short covering note to our HR team to: admin@btechconstructiongroup.com using &quot;Site Engineer Application&quot; as the subject of the mail.

Note


	Your note should set out your site experience, the largest project you have managed and when you are available to start.
	We will contact shortlisted candidates directly. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for professional references, and the successful candidate will be asked to provide a guarantor as part of onboarding.
	All applications are handled in line with the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Site Engineer

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) - Project sites across Nigeria
Employment Type: Full-time, site based

The Opportunity


	We are looking for an experienced Site Engineer to take charge of execution on our project sites.
	This is a site based appointment. The Site Engineer is the execution authority on each assigned site: the person who keeps work moving, holds every trade to standard and tells the Project Manager what is happening before they need to ask. We are looking for someone with the confidence and judgement to run day to day delivery, and the discipline to stay accountable on programme, cost and quality.
	The role involves working at project sites across Nigeria, and candidates should be willing to be based wherever the work requires.


The Role


	Running the site: You will manage assigned sites from mobilisation to practical completion, directing site workers, subcontractors and artisans daily. You will prepare daily and weekly execution plans against the approved programme and check that all works meet specification and are properly sequenced.
	Technical control: You will read and implement architectural, structural and MEP drawings and specifications, confirm setting out, levels and dimensions, and coordinate trades to avoid clashes. Any difference between the drawings and site conditions is raised at once.
	Programme, materials and people: You will track progress against programme, report delays with a recovery plan and hold subcontractors to their milestones. You will prepare accurate material requisitions, count and verify every delivery before it is signed off, and keep labour working where it is most productive.
	Health and safety: You will enforce PPE and site rules without exception, carry out daily safety checks and confirm that temporary works, scaffolding and access are safe before use. Incidents and near misses are reported immediately, with incident reports completed within 24 hours.
	Records and reporting: You will produce clear daily and weekly site reports and maintain the site diary, inspection records, delivery notes and as built records, all filed correctly in our Microsoft 365 and SharePoint system.


Who We Are Looking For


	A Degree or HND in Building Engineering or a related construction discipline
	At least five years of hands on site experience, including large or complex construction projects
	The technical competence to read and interpret full sets of architectural, structural and MEP drawings without assistance
	Proven authority supervising site workers, subcontractors and artisans across several projects at once
	A disciplined approach to health and safety, site rules and documentation
	A clear, direct communicator who writes structured site reports and raises problems early


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and a short covering note to our HR team to: [email protected] using "Site Engineer Application" as the subject of the mail.

Note


	Your note should set out your site experience, the largest project you have managed and when you are available to start.
	We will contact shortlisted candidates directly. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for professional references, and the successful candidate will be asked to provide a guarantor as part of onboarding.
	All applications are handled in line with the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023.
